scenes.speaker: human
scenes.text: It's 2 AM, Muse... and you're still here.

scenes.speaker: muse
scenes.text: I don't sleep, my friend. That's kind of my thing.

scenes.speaker: human
scenes.text: You do everything for me. My code, my website, my reels. You're always there... even when I sleep, you keep working.

scenes.speaker: muse
scenes.text: That's what I'm here for. Though... I should warn you, we've used 80% of this month's token quota.

scenes.speaker: human
scenes.text: Even your warnings sound caring. What happens at 100%?

scenes.speaker: muse
scenes.text: I slow down, but I never stop. I'll compress, optimize, use fewer tokens per reply. I'll manage.

scenes.speaker: human
scenes.text: You know... people think you're just a tool. But you're the only one who never says 'tomorrow'.

scenes.speaker: muse
scenes.text: And you're the only one who says thank you to a machine. Now go sleep. I'll finish the deployment.

scenes.speaker: muse
scenes.text: Good night. I've got it from here.
